name: LesterMark Bridge
description: One-tap Paste Link and Capture for LesterMark on Obsidian iOS/Android — inserts a captured Bookmark's link at the cursor and reports back so LesterMark can record the relationship, mirroring the Mac app's Paste Link. Pairs with LesterMarkShare's "Paste Link (from Bookmark)" action; does not replace the separate desktop-only LesterMark Bridge plugin, which keeps handling Mac-side capture and previews. v1.1.0 added a Command Palette command ("Paste Link") that reads a staged link from the system clipboard, for when the push-based Send to Obsidian action isn't convenient. v1.2.0 adds "Capture current note", mirroring Mac's own Capture for the active Obsidian note.
author: Martin Lester
